title: Get the HONOR 600 5G and HONOR X9d 5G with Globe GPlan Plus and enjoy a FREE bluetooth speaker II

blocks.text: Global AI device provider HONOR Philippines is making the holiday season more exciting for Filipino consumers with special HONOR Holideals through Globe GPlan Plus. Customers can get the HONOR 600 5G and HONOR X9d 5G with flexible postpaid plans, generous data inclusions, and a FREE HONOR Bluetooth Speaker II worth PHP 1,999 with every device.
Designed to keep users connected and powered throughout the day, the HONOR 600 5G and HONOR X9d 5G offer powerful smartphone experiences paired with Globe’s 5G connectivity and postpaid benefits.
Get More with HONOR 600 5G and HONOR X9d 5G on Globe GPlan Plus

Enjoy the HONOR 600 5G with Globe GPlan Plus 1299 for a one-time cash-out of PHP 24,700 or an installment rate of PHP 1,029.16 per month for 24 months. The plan includes 30GB of swappable data, 12 months of free unlimited 5G, unlimited all-net calls and texts with landline access, and Globe Scam Protect. Customers will also receive a FREE HONOR Bluetooth Speaker II worth PHP 1,999 with their device.

For those interested in the HONOR X9d 5G, it is available through Globe GPlan Plus 999 with no lock-up period. Customers can get the device for a one-time cash-out of PHP 19,000 or an installment rate of PHP 834 per month for 24 months. Subscribers can enjoy 20GB of swappable data, 12 months of free unlimited 5G, and unlimited all-net calls and texts with landline access, plus a FREE HONOR Bluetooth Speaker II worth PHP 1,999.

The HONOR 600 5G and HONOR X9d 5G are available through participating Globe Stores nationwide and online starting November 9, 2026. Visit your nearest Globe Store to learn more about the offers and get your preferred device. For more details, visit https://bit.ly/Globe_H600_PR and https://bit.ly/Globe_X9d_PR.

For more information about HONOR Philippines, you may visit: https://www.honor.com/ph/.
